Band and DJ recommendations for Carina & Sam’s wedding party at Petersham Nurseries, starting with a live set centred on British rock and indie, alongside pop favourites and plenty of electric guitar. Followed by a DJ set that builds naturally into a fun, feel-good party, with the option to add live instrumentation and/or vocals.

  • Indicative Artist Fees: exclude VAT, travel, accommodation & hospitality expenses (artists are travelling from and living locally unless otherwise stated).
  • Availability Holds & Fees: valid up to 15 days.
  • Format: Various formats available depending on the artist and desired feel. Where appropriate, artists can roam, moving naturally through the space rather than from a fixed position.
  • Repertoire: Artists have extensive, adaptable repertoires, with additional tracks available on request, subject to suitability, fee and preparation time. DJs are comfortable working with clients & briefs.
  • Styling: Artists can be styled to complement the event aesthetic and dress code.

Main Bands

These bands combine a rock and blues sensibility with extensive repertoires spanning familiar indie, alt rock and pop classics. With the flexibility to tailor their set to a host’s favourites, they bring amazing guitar-led energy and musical credibility to drive the party and get a dance floor pumping!

DJs

These options have been curated around the brief and current artist availability, with scope to refine the direction or bring in further artists based on feedback.
We may also still be awaiting schedules, and will add additional artists as they become available.

  • Ready to book: If you'd like to go ahead with any of the artists, let us know and we can get the booking process underway. A 50% deposit is required to secure the selected artist and date.

Proposal Terms

  • This proposal and recommendations are provided solely for evaluating entertainment options for this event and may be shared internally for planning purposes but should not be shared externally with artists, agencies or unrelated third parties.
  • Artists and suppliers introduced or recommended by Miro Sounds must be booked through Miro Sounds unless otherwise agreed in writing.
  • If an introduced artist or supplier is subsequently approached or booked directly, Miro Sounds reserves the right to charge an appropriate fee.
  • Project management, logistics coordination and onsite support are charged separately where required, based on the scope of the event and confirmed at booking.

About Us

We curate exceptional music for unforgettable events. From the familiar to the fresh, the refined to the raw, we're here to help you find the perfect pairing of sound & setting for every moment.

Bringing 15 years of expertise across music, events and sound curation, we source from a trusted global network of phenomenal musicians, handpicking talent tailored for each event, without the restrictions of a fixed roster, ensuring every experience feels truly personal.

Tell us the vision and we'll take it from there, fine-tuning every element to make sure it all flows seamlessly - initial consultation, genre & artist curation, booking & logistics, onsite management.

Rory MacInnes - Founder
